title: ResNet18d, 600 epochs, trained at 288 px (--img 288)
summary: Train 288 px, 600 ep: best single model (OOF 0.8449 at inference 352)
hypothesis: Training at higher resolution keeps detail that the RandomResizedCrop at 224 discards.
findings: Highest single-model OOF in the project (0.8449 at inference 352).
Evaluated at 224 it is the worst (0.7698): the model must be run at a larger size than it was trained on.

evidence.code: Training code is in code/ (copied from the team server export, 2026-11-12). Referenced by md5: train.py 56d4db01cdd6c2c46e7b9b3b789324fe (before the 2026-11-12 patch that added --img and corrupt_v5; default behaviour unchanged), dq.py e3e270bdcdf254ad369b1cb3c345e5e9.
